explication: M3 Play is an Android music player whose central workflow is browsing or searching music, building a queue, and playing it through a Media3 service; the UI also presents lyrics and playback controls. Its repository includes local library persistence, YouTube/InnerTube access, Spotify import and account features, listening-together support, music recognition, and appearance customization. The README documents player capabilities; sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX establish several internal links. Other subsystem links are omitted where their callers were not shown.
